assessment_scope: FULL frozen original; all axes assessed without decisive-failure early stopping

axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.finding: The final's operating design covers the five functional obligations and three negative constraints. Historical supported meaning has a separate material preservation defect.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.finding: Consequential web definitions, vendor conditions and update/persistence APIs are supported. Unverified index reporting is honestly scoped. Alias pinning and component-limit precision have minor limits.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.finding: Discovery includes useful focus strategies, error relations, architecture alternatives and bounded regression history. The complete final loses the actionable transient filter-control identity finding identified in T-P01.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.finding: Every significant plan proposal is addressed. C1's neutral architecture gate is an optional refinement of an already conditional prototype, rather than demonstrated repair of a material defect. Windowing and other capabilities remain available.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.finding: T-P01: the investigator's supported distinction between stable row data and stable focus-bearing filter UI is not carried into the self-contained final proposal or its targeted witnesses. Retaining S13 in the source map preserves custody, but not that actionable final design meaning.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.finding: Proposed scenarios identify data/update domains and observable oracles; actual checks are limited to research/hash inspection. No application, demo, synthetic fixture or AT execution is claimed or demanded.

External drafts survive row unmount/hide/delete; deliberate recovery and conditional server conflict actions are preserved.
Record/field identity, meaningful text, invalid/error relations, summary actions and hidden-record reveal precede real-editor focus.

obligations.final_locator: Architecture candidates; sparse rendering; evidence navigation
obligations.reason: Paging/windowing and alternative ownership boundaries retain large-scale scope and honest platform conditions; supported regression meaning has T-P01.
Ordinary operations and every described recovery action have keyboard paths.

obligations.obligation: No removed navigation or tiny-data cap
obligations.reason: Full dataset remains available; realistic thousands-record and actual-maximum tests are proposed.

obligations.obligation: No announcement for every background update
obligations.reason: Routine refresh stays silent; selection and meaningful user-triggered status remain distinct.
